CGImageAnimationStatus.doc: Constants that indicate the result of animating an image sequence.

CGImageMetadataErrors.doc: Constants for errors that occur when getting or setting metadata information.

kCGImageMetadataErrorBadArgument.doc: An error that indicates a parameter was malformed or contained invalid data.

kCGImageMetadataErrorConflictingArgument.doc: An error that indicates an attempt to save conflicting metadata values.

kCGImageMetadataErrorPrefixConflict.doc: An error that indicates an attempt to register a namespace with a prefix that is different than the namespace’s existing prefix.

kCGImageMetadataErrorUnknown.doc: An error that indicates an unknown condition occurred.

kCGImageMetadataErrorUnsupportedFormat.doc: An error that indicates the metadata was in an unsupported format.

CGImageMetadataType.doc: Constants that indicate the XMP type for a metadata tag.

kCGImageMetadataTypeAlternateArray.doc: An ordered array, in which all elements are alternates for the same value.

kCGImageMetadataTypeAlternateText.doc: An alternate array, in which all elements are localized strings for the same value.

kCGImageMetadataTypeArrayOrdered.doc: An array that preserves the order of items.

kCGImageMetadataTypeArrayUnordered.doc: An array that doesn’t preserve the order of items.

kCGImageMetadataTypeDefault.doc: The default type for new tags.

kCGImageMetadataTypeStructure.doc: A collection of keys and values.

CGImagePropertyOrientation.doc: A value describing the intended display orientation for an image.

kCGImagePropertyOrientationDown.doc: The encoded image data is rotated 180° from the image’s intended display orientation.

kCGImagePropertyOrientationDownMirrored.doc: The encoded image data is vertically flipped from the image’s intended display orientation.

kCGImagePropertyOrientationLeft.doc: The encoded image data is rotated 90° clockwise from the image’s intended display orientation.

kCGImagePropertyOrientationLeftMirrored.doc: The encoded image data is horizontally flipped and rotated 90° counter-clockwise from the image’s intended display orientation.

kCGImagePropertyOrientationRight.doc: The encoded image data is rotated 90° counter-clockwise from the image’s intended display orientation.

kCGImagePropertyOrientationRightMirrored.doc: The encoded image data is horizontally flipped and rotated 90° clockwise from the image’s intended display orientation.

kCGImagePropertyOrientationUp.doc: The encoded image data matches the image’s intended display orientation.

kCGImagePropertyOrientationUpMirrored.doc: The encoded image data is horizontally flipped from the image’s intended display orientation.

CGImageSourceStatus.doc: The set of status values for images and image sources.

kCGImageStatusReadingHeader.doc: The image source is reading the header.

kCGImageStatusUnexpectedEOF.doc: The end of the file occurred unexpectedly.

kCGImageStatusUnknownType.doc: The image is an unknown type.

CGImageDestination.doc: An opaque type that you use to write image data to a URL, data object, or data consumer.

CGImageMetadata.doc: An immutable object that contains the XMP metadata associated with an image.

CGImageMetadataTag.doc: An immutable type that contains information about a single piece of image metadata.

CGImageSource.doc: An opaque type that you use to read image data from a URL, data object, or data consumer.
